model_interpretation.claim: Assigning four output particles to each thread should reuse each loaded source position and mass across four target-force accumulations, reducing repeated source loads. Four accumulators per target may raise register use and lower occupancy, so the factor-four mapping and 1024 logical outputs per 256-thread block are a measured candidate, not a predicted speedup.

model_interpretation.claim: A factor-three target tile with 128 threads (384 outputs per block) tests an intermediate register/reuse tradeoff between the valid factor-two and factor-four candidates. Earlier factor-two candidates were faster than factor four but slower than baseline; whether factor three improves that balance must be established by the controller's full correctness checks and official timing.
